correctness.rationale: Unique nonnegative-gap parametrization; exact integer rational generating identity independently built and checked; all four polynomial remainders 864,32,6,-12 verified; every prime at least five has reduced denominator H. Necessity of period follows from cyclotomic root orders 3/4 and multiplicity six at 1; sufficiency follows from Frobenius and degree 16+T-22<T. Direct enumeration and modular sample checks supplement, not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A published conjectural period table highlights an explicit gap. The result supplies a uniform sharp formula for all primes p>=5, with a structural reason for the exceptional prime five, an exact rational generating function, and equally sharp pure and eventual periods. No prime-power or composite-period claims are made.
